en.title: Minimize Multiples Of Three
en.description:
One operation adds 1 to or subtracts 1 from a number. Find the minimum total number of operations needed to make every array element divisible by 3.

This site's standard input/output format and supplementary bounds follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤2×10^5), and the second line contains n integers (|a[i]|≤10^9).
en.output: Output the minimum number of operations.
en.explanation: For a number whose remainder modulo 3 is r, the minimum change is `min(r,3-r)`; summing these gives the answer. An independent oracle simulates the reachable set under +1/-1 step by step.
